|game_text=Deploy on Han or Back Door. Immediately draw two cards from Reserve Deck. Rebels are defense value +2 and are immune to attrition < 4. Imperials deploy +1 here. May place Effect in Lost Pile to cancel the targeting of a character weapon.
|errata_history=Versions of [[I Wonder Who They Found (V)]] in [[Virtual Set 9: Sanctuary Moon]], in date order (2 versions). Icons are written out in words. Found while adding the original pre-Remaster texts (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): a post by Kevin Brownell (“CubsFan”), the Committee's Marketing & Player Relations Advocate in the Committee's forum thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (“official rulings and errata issued by the Rules Committee”), 9 November 2005 ([https://web.archive.org/web/20060617231905/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?t=4438 Internet Archive capture of 17 June 2006]): “Effective immediately, these five virtual cards are being errata'd as follows:” “Deploy on Han or Back Door. Immediately draw two cards from Reserve Deck. Rebels are defense value +2 and are immune to attrition < 4. Imperials deploy +1 here. May place Effect in Lost Pile to cancel the targeting of a character weapon.” The post gives the text only (no slip image). This is the earliest surviving text of the card: the original Virtual Set 9 sheets (“Virtual Set 9 Final.pdf”, “VirtualSet9.pdf”, 2005–2006) are not preserved, so the text before this errata is unknown.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[I Wonder Who They Found (V) (Virtual Set 9) (Errata)]]): the Remaster sheet (official text as of 4 December 2006; [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards9.pdf VirtualCards9.pdf] on res.starwarsccg.org, the same file the Committee posted on swccgpc.com in 2007), page 2, slip 11, in the Committee's Remaster template: “Use 2 Force to deploy on Han or Back Door; draw top card of Used Pile. Non-Jedi, non-[[Permanent Weapon]] Rebels are defense value +2 and immune to attrition < 3. May place this Effect out of play to cancel the targeting of a weapon at same or related site.” (icons written out in words here.) '''What changed:''' the Remaster rewrote the card in the Committee's later wording (full text above). This is the current text of the Virtual Original card.
